properties.embankment: Eastern Kosi embankment (Koshi embankment) near Indo-Nepal border
properties.location_note: location precision not stated in source; 5 km block-centroid convention assumed; Coordinates intentionally null. Do not infer from district centroid.
properties.cause_note: Heavy monsoon rains and poor maintenance (Wikipedia 2008 Bihar flood). SSVK report attributes it to Water Resources Dept neglect (search summary).
properties.prior_warning_signs: Not established in sources read. Dinesh Kumar Mishra (EPW, 2008, per search summary) called it the 8th incident of its kind.
properties.impact_notes: Water passed ~3,675 m3/s per Wikipedia. Casualty figures conflict: 434 deaths (Wikipedia infobox, Govt of Bihar DDM report); 250 (Wikipedia body, ABC News 29 Aug 2008); 493 / 587 (search summary). ~53,800 people affected in Sunsari District Nepal (Wikipedia, UN OCHA May 2009). Search summary: course shift ~100 km east (Supaul situation report, unverified).
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2008_Bihar_flood (fetched: 18 Aug 2008, Kusaha VDC, Sunsari, heavy rain + poor maintenance, casualty figures)
